scope: Tiny paired local contracts;root-owned runtime qualification is separate.

cases.title: Capture actual finite streaming progress
cases.input_contract: Run the supplied three-occurrence stream with ID deduplication and return a bounded observation record.
cases.expected: Input count 3, state rows 2 and exact committed bag 1:100,2:200.
cases.verification: Join the progress record with actual readback and inactive-query evidence.

cases.title: Interpret state and sink metrics with units
cases.input_contract: Require a state operator and a nonnegative memory-used measurement;preserve unknown or negative sink-row sentinel values as unavailable.
cases.expected: State memory is reported in bytes. A missing or negative sink output count is not converted into zero.
cases.verification: Check the real state record and explicit None/-1 normalization controls.

cases.title: Observe bounded state growth across restart
cases.input_contract: Add a new ID 3:300 and restart the same compatible checkpoint.
cases.expected: One new input row, state rows grow 2 to 3, and output gains 3:300.
cases.verification: Compare actual state totals, query identity and exact committed rows.

cases.title: Distinguish empty input from a stuck query
cases.input_contract: Run a separate AvailableNow query over an empty owned input directory.
cases.expected: Zero admitted rows and a terminated query;state/sink metrics may be absent.
cases.verification: Assert zero input and termination without fabricating an output Parquet schema.

cases.title: Diagnose three seeded incident records
cases.input_contract: For the explicitly synthetic incident fixtures, choose one reversible check for skew, growing state and zero admitted input.
cases.expected: Inspect key/partition distribution;inspect watermark/key-retention policy;inspect source discovery respectively.
cases.verification: Compare the three exact recommendations and state one success observation for each.

cases.title: Sanitize evidence with an allowlist
cases.input_contract: Keep only stage_id, task_id, run_ms and input_records from a supplied task-event dictionary containing fake credential fields.
cases.expected: Exact four-field record, with fake token/password absent.
cases.verification: Assert field set and values;do not print the unfiltered input.

golden.unknown_metric: None or negative sentinel is unavailable,not zero
